title: Assignment from a block code
statement: Let $T$ be a conjunction of literals on distinct coordinates, with width at most $w$, and let $P$ be a set of positions among its literals. Given an assignment $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, form the block code on the embedded positions using, at each such position, the corresponding assignment bit adjusted by the literal's required sign. The assignment constructed from this block code for $T$ agrees with $x$ at the coordinate of every literal whose position lies in $P$.
hypotheses_covered: A term T on n coordinates
The width of T is at most w
A set P of literal positions
An assignment x in the n-dimensional Boolean cube
A literal position j belonging to P
